paper.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
paper.central_claim: DSPy 把 LM 流水线抽象为文本变换图，通过可参数化的声明式模块与 teleprompter 编译器（自举示例+搜索，可选微调），让简短程序在无手工提示的情况下超过 few-shot，并在多数情形追平专家示例，使小模型具备竞争力。
paper.scope_note: B类：trace→示例的编译/提示优化器；BootstrapFinetune 为权重更新(范围外)。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: subagent dispatched via claude-kimi model type; no run receipt exposed to the worker (not probed). Score arithmetic: coverage is a 0..1 fraction; lower/upper are 0..100.

sections_read: Appendix A–F(含 D、E 伪代码；附录 C 第三方提示仅部分阅读且非关键)
missing_sections: 附录 C 的第三方长提示未逐行核（非评分依据）

evidence.quote: We design a compiler that will optimize any DSPy pipeline to maximize a given metric.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心机制：编译器按给定指标优化流水线。

evidence.quote: outperform standard few-shot prompting (generally by over 25% and 65%, respectively)
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要性能主张；相对提升的口径混合 dev 与 test。

evidence.quote: As a result, the LM calls in existing LM pipelines and in popular developer frameworks are generally implemented using hard-coded ‘prompt templates’
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：手写提示模板脆弱、难扩展。

evidence.quote: The compiler inputs are the program, a few training inputs with optional labels, and a validation metric.
evidence.support_explanation: 编译输入：程序+少量训练输入+验证指标。

evidence.quote: The program’s metric is used to filter for multi-stage traces that together help the pipeline pass the metric.
evidence.support_explanation: 候选生成：按端到端指标过滤多阶段轨迹，作为各模块的示例。

evidence.quote: Typically, we are optimizing average quality using the metric with cross-validation over the training set or a validation set.
evidence.support_explanation: 参数选择：在训练/验证集上按指标选择。

evidence.quote: We focus primarily on automatically generating and selecting useful demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: 可优化参数包含 LM、指令与示例，实际主要优化示例，指令不优化。

evidence.quote: stores the supplied signature, an optional LM to use
evidence.support_explanation: Predict 模块把示例等参数存于模块内，编译结果即留存对象。

evidence.quote: We sample 200 and 300 question–answer pairs from the official training set for training and development, respectively. Our final evaluations use the 1.3k official test set examples.
which includes dev results as well as our evaluation of promising representatives of each approach on the test set
evidence.support_explanation: 表1 多行仅有 dev；test 只报“有希望的代表行”（在 dev 后挑选）。

evidence.quote: We report the average of 3–5 runs (depending on the setting) when applying such random sampling.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅随机采样的 LabeledFewShot 基线取 3–5 次平均，其余未见重复。

evidence.quote: This will generate demonstration chains for examples in the training set and optimize the selection of demonstrations (from this set) to self-improve the program’s modules. As the name indicates, this is done with random search, treating the selection of demonstrations as a parameter to optimize.
evidence.support_explanation: 随机搜索+验证集选择；与单次随机 fewshot 基线的搜索预算不对等。

evidence.quote: compiling generally runs on the order of minutes (or tens of minutes)
evidence.support_explanation: 编译成本定性说明；无令牌/美元。

evidence.quote: fewshot + human_CoT 78.6 72.4 34.3 33.7
evidence.support_explanation: 专家 CoT 示例行（GPT-3.5 dev/test；Llama2 dev/test）。

evidence.quote: bootstrap trainset 80.3 72.9 43.3 –
evidence.support_explanation: CoT 程序 bootstrap 行（Llama2 test 缺）。

evidence.quote: we can match or surpass this using bootstrap
evidence.support_explanation: bootstrap 追平/超过专家 CoT。

evidence.quote: we see that the prompt allows the LM to leverage the answer field for reasoning first
evidence.support_explanation: vanilla 的提升部分来自把答案字段变成推理空间。

evidence.quote: The marked result is evaluated on 50% of our test set due to cost.
evidence.support_explanation: HotPotQA 一格仅用一半测试集。

evidence.quote: The HotPotQA test set is hidden, so we reserve the official validation set for our testing, and sample 1000 examples for that.
evidence.support_explanation: HotPotQA 用官方验证集 1000 例作测试。

evidence.quote: Researchers are starting to apply discrete optimization and RL to find effective prompts, generally for a single logical LM call
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻：单次调用的提示优化。

evidence.quote: DSPy seeks to generalize this space: it offers a rich framework for optimizing arbitrary pipelines
evidence.support_explanation: 定位：对任意流水线做优化。

evidence.quote: When this is applied, the LM parameter of each module is updated to the new LM weights.
evidence.support_explanation: BootstrapFinetune 为权重更新，属范围外成分。

evidence.quote: An ensemble will bootstrap multiple copies of the same program, and then replace the program with a new one that runs them all in parallel and
evidence.support_explanation: 高阶程序优化仅为集成。

evidence.quote: we can replace hand-crafted prompt strings with concise and well-defined modules, without reducing quality or expressive power.
evidence.support_explanation: H1，评估目标。

evidence.quote: we leave reporting on such tasks under controlled experimental conditions to future work
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认其他任务未在受控条件下报告。

evidence.quote: We conducted an informal study to highlight this.
evidence.support_explanation: LangChain 提示数量比较为非正式。

evidence.quote: This program scores 39.3% answer EM and 46.0% passage accuracy on the dev set, using only 200 labeled inputs and 800 unlabeled questions.
evidence.support_explanation: T5-Large 微调结果（权重更新，范围外）。

signatures.object: DSPy 程序中各 Predict 模块的示例集合(demonstrations)
signatures.information: 训练输入(可无中间标签)、教师程序(默认为零样本版本)、最终输出指标；无测试数据
signatures.operation: 在高温下模拟教师程序，记录各模块输入/输出轨迹，只保留使端到端指标通过的轨迹作为候选示例
signatures.output: 每个模块带自动生成示例的程序
signatures.conditions: 指标可计算；至少有若干训练样本能通过
signatures.feedback: 端到端指标（对最终输出，无需中间标签）
signatures.selection_rule: 指标过滤 + 验证集上的随机搜索/Optuna 选择
signatures.persistence: 示例存入模块参数，成为编译后程序
signatures.later_use: 推理时提示格式化包含示例
signatures.claimed_effect: GSM8K、HotPotQA 上超过随机 few-shot，多数情形追平/超过专家示例
signatures.failure_boundary: 若训练样本无一通过则无示例；搜索预算与基线不对等；作者承认其他任务未受控报告

signatures.object: 编译产物的高阶组合与小模型微调
signatures.information: 已编译程序及其候选程序
signatures.operation: Ensemble 取前 7 个候选多数表决；BootstrapFinetune 用教师轨迹微调 T5/Llama（权重）
signatures.claimed_effect: 集成再提升；T5-Large 与大模型提示相当
signatures.failure_boundary: 权重更新属范围外；集成使推理成本增加

gap.author_gap: LM 调用多以手工提示模板实现，在多模块流水线中尤其脆弱，且难跨 LM/任务泛化。
gap.checked_gap: 真实、规模大；被固定的对象是提示串/示例/流水线参数，非权重，符合范围。最近邻（单次调用的提示优化 APE/OPRO/ProTeGi 等）已被引用但未做实证比较。
gap.lineage: 祖先：DSP(作者前作)、CoT/ReAct/Self-Consistency、STaR 式自举；最近邻：Guo 2023、Pryzant 2023(ProTeGi)、Yang 2023(OPRO)；框架对照：LangChain/LlamaIndex。版本为论文自述，本地无固定副本。

rs_pattern.reason: 把“手写提示/流水线设计”重述为“带指标的参数化程序的编译/超参选择”，复用随机搜索与 TPE 等成熟求解机器。

tactic_steps_checked: 重述为优化对象：参数=示例/指令/LM，目标=指标(E01,E04,E07)
复用现成求解：随机搜索、Optuna(E06,E12)
验证对应关系：经验性对照专家示例(E14,E15,E16)

success_failure_checks.success: 对应定理:unmet(经验性)；解锁新能力:met(模块可组合、小模型编译)；删除旧组件:met(去除手写提示)

matches.reason: C00/C21/C27 分别针对解释性度量、RL→监督、博弈，均不贴合，故 sub=null；也考虑过 relax_discrete_search_to_continuous/C22，但无可微/摊销松弛，故不选。

rs_pattern.resolves_problem_reason: 证明了在两个基准上编译优于随机示例，但未证明对“任意流水线/去除手工提示”成立，也未与同类优化器比较。

condition_checks.note: 贡献在搜索层：用端到端指标给多阶段流水线的模块记功

claims.text: 编译后的 DSPy 程序超过标准 few-shot（GPT-3.5 >25%，Llama2-13b-chat >65%）
claims.baseline_control: none、LabeledFewShot(随机 8 示例,3–5 次平均)
claims.selection_vs_test: dev 选择后少数行报 test
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在这两个基准上，bootstrap 编译使程序明显优于随机 few-shot；相对提升口径混合 dev/test。

claims.text: 无需手写演示即可追平/超过专家示例
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在 GSM8K CoT 上 dev 与 GPT-3.5 test 持平或略高；Llama2 test 缺失；证据窄。

claims.text: 小模型经编译可与大模型提示竞争
claims.allowed_conclusion: llama2 编译(非权重)在 HotPotQA 上接近 GPT-3.5；T5 微调属范围外。

assessment.evidence_level_note: 编译产物（示例等留存对象）在 dev 选择后于留出 test 子集上优于基线（作者报告）；非闭环，无 improver 证据。
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在 GSM8K 与 HotPotQA 上，GPT-3.5/Llama2-13b-chat 的 DSPy 程序经 bootstrap 编译后，在留出测试子集上明显优于随机 few-shot，并在部分设定追平专家示例；搜索预算对等与同类优化器对比缺失。

G.reason: 手写提示的瓶颈具体，非权重对象明确；与同类提示优化器的残余差距只在文字上界定。

M.reason: 签名-模块-teleprompter 机制可重建，端到端指标记功合理；“为何自举示例优于专家示例”主要靠经验。

X.reason: 候选生成、选择、留存位置、推理读取均有伪代码；无版本/回退，空轨迹等失败处理不详。

E.measurement.reason: 指标标准(EM/准确率)，有训练/开发/测试；GPT-3.5 版本与非确定性未说明。

E.causality.reason: 程序×编译器×LM 的网格有帮助，但 bootstrap 含 16 次验证集搜索而基线是单次随机示例，缺同预算 best-of-N 与同类优化器对照。

E.holdout.reason: 有独立 test 子集并报告 test；但报 test 的行是在 dev 之后挑选、公开基准污染未讨论、推广到“任意流水线”仅为轶事。

E.statistics.reason: 仅随机 few-shot 基线 3–5 次平均；其余单次，无 CI，dev 300 例的差距噪声不小。

E.cost.reason: 说明编译需数千次运行、分钟级；无令牌/美元，与基线不对等，小模型推理成本优势只是定性。

status_reason: 全文含附录已读；表1/2 部分格仅 dev。
rationale: 奠基性机制清晰、留出评测规范；但基线搜索预算不对等、统计弱、无同类优化器对比，强结论限于两个基准。
